FULL TEXT:
University Institute of Engineering and Technology
Panjab University, Sector-25, Chandigarh 160014
Project Staff Requirement
Applications are invited for the appointment of Project Assistant- 01 in DST funded project
entitled “Science Technology and Innovation Hub in Tele-Healthcare for Preventive Health”
for a period of 1 year OR coterminous with project depending upon the satisfactory performance of
the candidate at University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET), Sector-25, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.

Responsibilities:
 Assist in day-to-day implementation and coordination of project activities.
 Support data collection, data entry, validation, and maintenance of project records.
 Ensure proper functioning and basic troubleshooting of telemedicine equipment and IT
systems.
 Coordinate with healthcare providers, lab technicians, and field staff for seamless service
delivery.
 Prepare reports, documentation, and presentations as required by the project team.
 Provide logistical and administrative support for meetings, trainings, and field visits.
 Assist in procurement, inventory management, and financial documentation.
 Responsible for maintaining accounting records, checking the financial documents.
 Providing support to administrative related tasks in the accounts department.
 Assisting in administrative activities.
 Working at project implementation site in various states depending on the location of
deployment.
 Perform any other tasks assigned by the PI/Co-PIs
The incumbent is expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and maybe on holidays also for any
project exigency. Date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible/ shortlisted
candidates through email or phone. No separate call letters will be issued for the interview. No
TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview.
Candidates can apply within 7-days from date of advertisement through Google form Link
https://forms.gle/ope7e3doqVCjqow58
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE UIET,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
